# Compute Device Adaptation

## E1
Runtime Adaptation where we vary the use of the mt and cuda backed.

```{c}
if (c) {
  _ = with { #pragma cuda ... } : ... ;
} else {
  _ = with { #pragma nocuda ... } : ... ;
}
```

where c could be:
- prev_time_cuda < prev_time_nocuda
- prev_time_h2d + prev_time_d2h < prev_time_kernel
...
